items.title: Residential building section collapses in Dymer near Kyiv
items.summary: A Russian military correspondent reported that a section of an apartment building collapsed in Dymer, northwest of Kyiv, and that rescuers were working at the scene. The account blamed Ukrainian air defences, but did not provide evidence establishing the cause or report casualty figures.

items.title: Report says industrial facility struck in Lozova, Kharkiv region
items.summary: A Russian military correspondent reported that an industrial enterprise in Lozova, Kharkiv region, was hit during overnight strikes. The report did not identify the facility or provide details of damage or casualties.
